<script>
(function(){
  var LABELS = ["Cover","Dedication","Three Months","Sweet as Honey","That Smile",
                "Wide-Eyed Wonder","Little One in Bloom","Over the Moon",
                "To Be Continued","Keepsake"];
  var reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  function start(){
    var el = document.getElementById("book");
    var shell = document.querySelector(".book-shell");
    var prev = document.getElementById("prev");
    var next = document.getElementById("next");
    var indLabel = document.getElementById("indLabel");
    var indProg = document.getElementById("indProg");
    var hint = document.getElementById("hint");
    var openHint = document.querySelector(".open-hint");

    var pf = new St.PageFlip(el, {
      width: 432, height: 576,
      size: "stretch",
      minWidth: 300, maxWidth: 480,
      minHeight: 400, maxHeight: 720,
      drawShadow: true,
      maxShadowOpacity: 0.5,
      flippingTime: reduce ? 360 : 780,
      showCover: true,
      usePortrait: true,
      autoSize: true,
      mobileScrollSupport: false,
      swipeDistance: 24,
      clickEventForward: true,
      useMouseEvents: true
    });

    pf.loadFromHTML(document.querySelectorAll("#book .page"));
    var total = pf.getPageCount();

    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ shell.classList.add("ready"); });

    function update(i){
      var atStart = i <= 0;
      var atEnd = i >= total - 1;
      prev.disabled = atStart;
      next.disabled = atEnd;
      indLabel.textContent = LABELS[i] || "";
      if (atStart){ indProg.textContent = "tap to open"; }
      else if (atEnd){ indProg.textContent = "the end"; }
      else { indProg.textContent = "page " + i + " of " + (total - 2); }
      if (openHint) openHint.style.display = atStart ? "" : "none";
    }
    update(pf.getCurrentPageIndex());

    var dismissed = false;
    function dismissHint(){ if(!dismissed){ dismissed = true; hint.classList.add("hide"); } }

    pf.on("flip", function(e){ update(e.data); dismissHint(); });

    next.addEventListener("click", function(){ pf.flipNext(); dismissHint(); });
    prev.addEventListener("click", function(){ pf.flipPrev(); dismissHint(); });

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight"){ pf.flipNext(); dismissHint(); }
      else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"){ pf.flipPrev(); dismissHint(); }
    });

    // keep editable cover line from triggering a page turn
    var nm = document.querySelector(".cover-foot .nm");
    if (nm){ ["click","mousedown","touchstart","pointerdown"].forEach(function(ev){
      nm.addEventListener(ev, function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
    }); }

    window.addEventListener("resize", function(){
      clearTimeout(window.__rz);
      window.__rz = setTimeout(function(){ try{ pf.update(); }catch(_){} }, 180);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "complete") start();
  else window.addEventListener("load", start);
})();
</script>
